entries.b6a98a643a4ddb0e: The company has formulated a medium-term management plan (from the fiscal year ended March 2026 to the fiscal year ended March 2030) themed on taking on the challenge of new value and markets based on "making good products," and takes four basic strategies: a sales strategy, a cost strategy, a sustainability strategy and a financial strategy. In the sales strategy, it will expand sales domains and develop new markets, such as expansion of the frozen food business, home-delivery lunch boxes for co-ops, and products for cafe chains. In the cost strategy, it will work on reducing costs by reviewing procurement methods for main ingredients, mechanization and labor saving, and promotion of DX.
